name: Bookmarks
description: Save links with projects, tags and notes. Pin the ones you use most; filter by project or tag.

create.description: Save a link. Takes url (with optional title), or text such as "Rust book doc.rust-lang.org/book #rust": the address is the link, #words are tags, other words the title. Optional tags, project, note, pinned. An address already saved returns that bookmark.

url.description: Web address to save (https:// added if missing; tracking parameters removed). Required unless text is given.

text.description: Quick-save text instead of url, e.g. "Rust book doc.rust-lang.org/book #rust": the address is the link, #words are tags, other words the title.

title.description: Title (up to 300 characters); defaults to the site name.

update.description: Change a bookmark's url, title, project, tags, note or pinned.

title.description: New title; empty resets it to the site name.

tags.description: Replaces all tags, comma-separated; empty clears them.

pin.description: Pin or unpin a bookmark (pinned: true/false); without pinned it flips.

pinned.description: true to pin, false to unpin; omit to flip.

visit.description: Count a visit and remember when.

delete.confirm: Move this bookmark to the trash?

restore.description: Bring a bookmark back from trash.

id.description: Id of a bookmark in the trash.

tag_names.sql: WITH RECURSIVE s(tag, rest) AS (SELECT '', tags || ', ' FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND tags IS NOT NULL AND tags <> '' UNION ALL SELECT trim(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ', ') - 1)), substr(rest, instr(rest, ', ') + 2) FROM s WHERE rest <> '') SELECT tag AS value, COUNT(*) AS count FROM s WHERE tag <> '' GROUP BY tag ORDER BY count DESC, tag LIMIT 60
tag_names.description: All tags in use with how many bookmarks have each, most used first.

focus_suggestions.sql: WITH RECURSIVE s(tag, rest) AS (SELECT '', tags || ', ' FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND tags IS NOT NULL AND tags <> '' UNION ALL SELECT trim(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ', ') - 1)), substr(rest, instr(rest, ', ') + 2) FROM s WHERE rest <> ''), names(value) AS (SELECT project FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND project IS NOT NULL AND project <> '' UNION ALL SELECT tag FROM s WHERE tag <> '') SELECT value, COUNT(*) AS count FROM names GROUP BY value ORDER BY count DESC, value LIMIT 30
focus_suggestions.description: Project and tag names with counts, used to suggest a page focus.

list.sql: SELECT id, url, title, CASE WHEN instr(CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END, '/') > 0 THEN substr(CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END, 1, instr(CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END, '/') - 1) ELSE CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END END AS host, CASE WHEN instr(CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END, '/') > 0 THEN substr(CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END, 1, instr(CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END, '/') - 1) ELSE CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END END || COALESCE(' · ' || NULLIF(trim(substr(replace(note, char(10), ' '), 1, 100)), ''), '') AS subtitle, project, tags, CASE WHEN tags IS NOT NULL AND tags <> '' THEN '#' || replace(tags, ', ', ' #') END AS tags_label, note, COALESCE(visits, 0) AS visits, CASE WHEN COALESCE(visits, 0) = 0 THEN NULL WHEN visits = 1 THEN '1 visit' ELSE visits || ' visits' END AS visits_label, pinned, CASE WHEN created_at IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN date((created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = ?6 THEN strftime('%H:%M', (created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN date((created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = date(?6, '-1 day') THEN 'Yesterday ' || strftime('%H:%M', (created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN date((created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch') > date(?6, '-7 day') THEN CASE strftime('%w', (created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN '0' THEN 'Sun' WHEN '1' THEN 'Mon' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tue' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wed' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thu' WHEN '5' THEN 'Fri' ELSE 'Sat' END || ' ' || strftime('%H:%M', (created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch') ELSE CAST(strftime('%d', (created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) || ' ' || substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(strftime('%m', (created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3) || CASE WHEN substr(date((created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) <> substr(?6, 1, 4) THEN ' ' || substr(date((created_at + ?5) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) ELSE '' END END AS added, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND (?1 IS NULL OR ?1 = '' OR title LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR url LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR tags LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR note LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR project LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%') AND (?2 IS NULL OR ?2 = '' OR project = ?2) AND (?3 IS NULL OR ?3 = '' OR instr(', ' || COALESCE(tags, '') || ', ', ', ' || ?3 || ', ') > 0) AND pinned = 1) = 0 THEN NULL WHEN pinned = 1 THEN 'Pinned' ELSE 'Bookmarks' END AS section FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND (?1 IS NULL OR ?1 = '' OR title LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR url LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR tags LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR note LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR project LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%') AND (?2 IS NULL OR ?2 = '' OR project = ?2) AND (?3 IS NULL OR ?3 = '' OR instr(', ' || COALESCE(tags, '') || ', ', ', ' || ?3 || ', ') > 0) ORDER BY pinned DESC, CASE ?4 WHEN 'visits' THEN -COALESCE(visits, 0) WHEN 'opened' THEN -COALESCE(visited_at, 0) ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN ?4 = 'title' THEN lower(title) END, COALESCE(created_at, 0) DESC, id DESC LIMIT 500
list.description: Bookmarks matching a search, project and tag, pinned first.

q.description: Text to find in title, url, tags, note or project; empty for all.

project.description: Exact project name; empty for any.

sort.description: "visits" (most visited), "opened" (recently opened), "title" (A-Z); anything else or empty sorts newest first.

bookmark.sql: SELECT id, url, title, CASE WHEN instr(CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END, '/') > 0 THEN substr(CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END, 1, instr(CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END, '/') - 1) ELSE CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END END AS host, COALESCE(tags, '') AS tags, COALESCE(project, '') AS project, COALESCE(note, '') AS note, pinned, NULLIF(substr(COALESCE(' · Added ' || CASE WHEN created_at IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN date((created_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = ?3 THEN strftime('%H:%M', (created_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN date((created_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = date(?3, '-1 day') THEN 'Yesterday ' || strftime('%H:%M', (created_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN date((created_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') > date(?3, '-7 day') THEN CASE strftime('%w', (created_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN '0' THEN 'Sun' WHEN '1' THEN 'Mon' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tue' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wed' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thu' WHEN '5' THEN 'Fri' ELSE 'Sat' END || ' ' || strftime('%H:%M', (created_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') ELSE CAST(strftime('%d', (created_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) || ' ' || substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(strftime('%m', (created_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3) || CASE WHEN substr(date((created_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) <> substr(?3, 1, 4) THEN ' ' || substr(date((created_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) ELSE '' END END, '') || COALESCE(' · ' || CASE WHEN COALESCE(visits, 0) = 0 THEN NULL WHEN visits = 1 THEN '1 visit' ELSE visits || ' visits' END, '') || COALESCE(' · Last opened ' || CASE WHEN visited_at IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN date((visited_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = ?3 THEN strftime('%H:%M', (visited_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN date((visited_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = date(?3, '-1 day') THEN 'Yesterday ' || strftime('%H:%M', (visited_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN date((visited_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') > date(?3, '-7 day') THEN CASE strftime('%w', (visited_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN '0' THEN 'Sun' WHEN '1' THEN 'Mon' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tue' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wed' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thu' WHEN '5' THEN 'Fri' ELSE 'Sat' END || ' ' || strftime('%H:%M', (visited_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') ELSE CAST(strftime('%d', (visited_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) || ' ' || substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(strftime('%m', (visited_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3) || CASE WHEN substr(date((visited_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) <> substr(?3, 1, 4) THEN ' ' || substr(date((visited_at + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) ELSE '' END END, ''), 4), '') AS info FROM bookmarks WHERE id = ?1 AND _deleted IS NULL

projects.sql: SELECT '' AS project, 'All' AS label, COUNT(*) AS count, (?1 IS NULL OR ?1 = '') AS selected, 0 AS k FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND project IS NOT NULL AND project <> '') UNION ALL SELECT project, project, COUNT(*), project = ?1, 1 FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND project IS NOT NULL AND project <> '' GROUP BY project ORDER BY k, project
projects.description: Projects with bookmark counts, plus an "All" row, marking the selected one.

project.description: Currently selected project, marked selected; empty selects All.

tags.sql: WITH RECURSIVE s(tag, rest) AS (SELECT '', tags || ', ' FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND tags IS NOT NULL AND tags <> '' AND (?1 IS NULL OR ?1 = '' OR project = ?1) UNION ALL SELECT substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ', ') - 1), substr(rest, instr(rest, ', ') + 2) FROM s WHERE rest <> '') SELECT tag, '#' || tag AS label, COUNT(*) AS count, tag = ?2 AS selected, CASE WHEN tag = ?2 THEN '' ELSE tag END AS next FROM s WHERE tag <> '' GROUP BY tag ORDER BY tag = ?2 DESC, count DESC, tag LIMIT 40
tags.description: Tags with counts within a project, marking the selected one.

project.description: Only count bookmarks in this project; empty for all.

tag.description: Currently selected tag, listed first and marked selected.

project_names.sql: SELECT DISTINCT project FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND project IS NOT NULL AND project <> '' ORDER BY project
project_names.description: Names of all projects in use.

summary.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) || CASE COUNT(*) WHEN 1 THEN ' link' ELSE ' links' END || CASE WHEN SUM(pinned = 1) > 0 THEN ' · ' || SUM(pinned = 1) || ' pinned' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(project, '')) > 0 THEN ' · ' || COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(project, '')) || CASE COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(project, '')) WHEN 1 THEN ' project' ELSE ' projects' END ELSE '' END AS label FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL
summary.description: One-line count of links, pinned links and projects.

recent.sql: SELECT id, url, title, CASE WHEN instr(CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END, '/') > 0 THEN substr(CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END, 1, instr(CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END, '/') - 1) ELSE CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END END AS host, pinned, CASE WHEN pinned = 1 THEN 'Pinned' END AS pin_label, CASE WHEN tags IS NOT NULL AND tags <> '' THEN '#' || replace(tags, ', ', ' #') END AS tags_label FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND (?1 IS NULL OR ltrim(?1, '#') = '' OR project = ltrim(?1, '#') COLLATE NOCASE OR instr(', ' || lower(COALESCE(tags, '')) || ', ', ', ' || lower(ltrim(?1, '#')) || ', ') > 0 OR title LIKE '%' || ltrim(?1, '#') || '%' OR note LIKE '%' || ltrim(?1, '#') || '%') AND (?2 IS NULL OR ?2 = '' OR project = ?2 COLLATE NOCASE) AND (?3 IS NULL OR ?3 = '' OR EXISTS (WITH RECURSIVE f(tag, rest) AS (SELECT '', ?3 || ',' UNION ALL SELECT lower(ltrim(trim(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ',') - 1)), '#')), substr(rest, instr(rest, ',') + 1) FROM f WHERE rest <> '') SELECT 1 FROM f WHERE tag <> '' AND instr(', ' || lower(COALESCE(tags, '')) || ', ', ', ' || tag || ', ') > 0)) ORDER BY pinned DESC, COALESCE(visits, 0) DESC, COALESCE(visited_at, 0) DESC, id DESC LIMIT 6
recent.description: Up to 6 bookmarks, pinned and most visited first, optionally narrowed.

focus.description: Project name, #tag, or text found in title or note; empty for any.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags; bookmarks with any of them match.

trash.sql: SELECT id, title, CASE WHEN instr(CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END, '/') > 0 THEN substr(CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END, 1, instr(CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END, '/') - 1) ELSE CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END END AS host FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NOT NULL ORDER BY _deleted DESC LIMIT 100
trash.description: Bookmarks in the trash, most recently deleted first.

search.sql: SELECT id, title, url, CASE WHEN instr(CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END, '/') > 0 THEN substr(CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END, 1, instr(CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END, '/') - 1) ELSE CASE WHEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 1, 4) = 'www.' THEN substr(substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3), 5) ELSE substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3) END END || COALESCE(' · ' || NULLIF(project, ''), '') AS subtitle FROM bookmarks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND (title LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR url LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR tags LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR note LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR project LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%') ORDER BY pinned DESC, COALESCE(visits, 0) DESC LIMIT 8
search.description: Up to 8 bookmarks whose title, url, tags, note or project contain the text.
